_comment: Collector configuration. Each source is optional; a failing source is logged and skipped. See docs/pipeline.md.

queries.label: coding agents in use
queries.query: ("claude code" OR codex OR "cursor agent" OR devin OR openclaw OR "gemini cli" OR "copilot agent") ("I built" OR "I had" OR "I let" OR "I asked" OR "I used" OR "built me" OR "built this" OR overnight OR "saved me" OR automated) -is:retweet -is:reply lang:en

queries.label: personal and business agents
queries.query: ("my agent" OR "my AI agent" OR "an AI agent" OR "chatgpt agent" OR manus OR n8n OR "claude cowork" OR "openai operator") (booked OR negotiated OR filed OR "found me" OR "saved me" OR "handles my" OR "runs my" OR "for my business" OR "automated my") -is:retweet -is:reply lang:en

queries.label: agents at work
queries.query: (agent OR agents OR "claude code" OR codex OR chatgpt) ("my research" OR "my lab" OR "my students" OR "my clients" OR "my patients" OR "our team" OR "my company") (built OR automated OR "set up" OR replaced OR saved) -is:retweet -is:reply lang:en
